title: Common definitions
description: Shared primitives so Property, Sponsor and PropertySponsor can never disagree about an ID, ZIP or category.

property_id.description: Primary key of a Property. Example: PROP-0001.

sponsor_id.description: Primary key of a Sponsor. Example: SPN-004.

zip_code.description: 5-digit US ZIP. Kept as a string so leading zeros survive (e.g. 02139).

state.description: Two-letter uppercase US state or DC code.

phone.description: E.164-style with dashes. Seed data uses the reserved fictional 555-01xx range.

placement_rank.description: 1 = featured first. At most 3 sponsors are shown per property.
